282121731.description:
This is a half of an agate geode with one flat polished face. The face shows blue and gray banding around a small cavity lined with tiny sparkling crystals. The back and sides are rough, with a brown and gray stone exterior with yellow tan patches. It can be displayed as a desk or shelf accent, or kept as a mineral specimen.

Condition: Pre-owned, no visible damage. The back is naturally rough, and the polished face has a few small surface marks and mineral specks.
